title: A failed action loses its inputs
text: The transition `call` takes a `request` and the one `slot`, and returns the slot when its action succeeds. When the action throws, the executor emits `TransitionFailed` and deposits nothing, and there is no rollback: the consumed slot is gone, so every later request waits forever.

steps.text: Requests arrive through `inject()`. The action succeeds: `reply` gets a token and the slot comes back.

The action throws. The request and the slot were consumed when the firing started; nothing is deposited, and the third request can never fire `call`. A firing also fails when output validation rejects what the action wrote. To keep the slot, catch the error in the action and route it to an `Xor` branch that returns the slot.
